title: AI Product Builder
description:
Quanta Ops automates back-office work for logistics companies with LLM agents.

What you will do
- Own an agent workflow end to end: discovery with customers, prototype, production.
- Write and ship production Python code for agent tools and evaluations.
- Define quality metrics for agents and run evals.

Must have
- Strong Python: 3+ years writing production Python code.
- Experience shipping an LLM agent to production.
- Product ownership.

Nice to have
- Logistics domain.
